name: Broom
description: A long wooden handle with a stitched straw head.
notes: Lies along x with the straw head flat in the xz plane, as flat-headed tools do. CHECK VOLUME (box/volume x20) is the long thin handle's bounding box, not a fault.

name: Down mattress
description: A single mattress filled with down, quilted in soft channels.
notes: Too big for a pack; the size is a placeholder until oversized carried items have a rule. Material source for cloth and stuffing.

name: Mattress
description: A single sprung mattress in striped ticking.
notes: Too big for a pack; the size is a placeholder until oversized carried items have a rule. No plaid or ticking print exists, so the stripes are raised strips. Steel springs inside are not modelled; salvage yields them.

name: RC car wheels
description: Four small treaded wheels from a toy buggy.
notes: One item is the set of four, laid two by two.

name: Thick rubber chunk
description: A thick slab cut from a tyre tread.

name: Rubber tyre strip
description: A long strip cut from a tyre, curled into a coil.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (box/volume x4.6) is the open middle of the coil; the strip itself matches the reference volume.

name: Sharp rock
description: A fist-sized stone with one rough knapped edge.
notes: Spawns outdoors more than in buildings; the usage tags are the nearest fit until wilderness loot has a tag.

name: Grenade launcher stock
description: A collapsible stock that lets an underbarrel grenade launcher fire on its own.
notes: Modelled closed. CHECK VOLUME (box/volume x5.5) is the open frame between the twin rods. Fitting it to a launcher needs a gun-part rule that does not exist yet.

name: Giant wasp stinger
description: A barbed black stinger as long as a hand, torn from a giant wasp.
notes: A harvest from a mutant wasp. It holds by the brown sheath; give it a weak pierce melee block if stingers become improvised weapons.

name: Paraffin wax
description: A broken block of white candle wax.
notes: No translucent white wax finish exists; wax-ivory is opaque.
